_meta.description: Cities, towns and villages of the National Address register, one row per register entry, with its centre point. The register id is kept as `ref` so a later import updates the same row; names are NOT unique (375 Arabic names occur more than once) and must never be used as keys. `rank` is the number of districts the register lists for the place (only 152 have any): it only decides which places a city picker offers first.
_meta.origin: https://maps.address.gov.sa (public National Address data), as republished at https://github.com/homaily/Saudi-Arabia-Regions-Cities-and-Districts (cities.json)
